data.order: Oldest date first; ties sorted ascending entry.seq; initial grid opens newest at bottom.

standalone.javascript: Vanilla IIFE; no jQuery, GSAP, Shopify SDK, theme globals or build/runtime imports. Shopify references are comments only.
standalone.bootstrap: Needs complete feature DOM, inline feature CSS, SVG sprite and JSON TlogData. Root #Tlog alone is not sufficient: #TlBar, #TlViewer, #TlToast are siblings; SVG sprite is before #Tlog.
standalone.pagination: pages=1 means fetchBatch is never called. For pages>1 it fetches current location with view=tlog-data&page=n using same-origin credentials, requiring server JSON or a static adaptation.
other_dom_contracts: SVG symbol IDs such as tl-heart/tl-info/tl-back/tl-play
standalone.isolation: Global listeners, global history.scrollRestoration=manual, global html tl-locked class and no cleanup API; should execute once on an isolated test page.

viewer_interactions.behavior: Tile click opens viewer with dialog state and hash #photo-ID; loaded tile copy animates transform+clipPath to fitted photo rectangle,380ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1). Close reverses when source tile is available. Back button, browser back/popstate and Escape close. Closing may center current tile rather than restore exact previous window offset.

Native horizontal page scroller, previous/next buttons, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight. Active photo is nearest scroll position. End buttons disabled. Metadata, info, heart, media player, strip and hash update with current photo.

Native horizontally scrolling strip tracks pages continuously. Strip scrubbing changes photo without slide; strip settles to current thumbnail after120ms. Clicking thumb jumps photo and smoothly centers strip. Haptics: navigator.vibrate(5), or hidden switch checkbox behavior on supported Safari.
Single photo tap after260ms hides/shows controls; if info open it closes info instead. Long press over500ms retains native save/context behavior.

Double tap within300ms and40px toggles zoom, zoom-in scale2.5. Two-finger pinch or Ctrl+wheel trackpad pinch scales around fingers/cursor. Zoom scale clamped from home*.6 through5. While zoomed, pan by pointer; horizontal page scroll disabled; zoom out restores controls prior visibility. Exit animation260ms.

Axis chosen after8px. Downward photo drag follows pointer with scale/background fade; closes after100px, or40px when gesture<250ms. Upward movement past40px reveals details. Downward40px hides details. Mouse horizontal drag manually updates pages scrollLeft and settles to next photo when appropriate.

Heart toggles current photo favorite, updates grid heart and saves browser-local storage. If opened from Favorites, viewer order includes only favorites plus initially opened item; changes filter when viewer closes.
Info button/upward gesture reveals caption, day/date, optional place, filename stem, file type and dimensions/MP or duration. Single tap, down gesture or Escape dismisses info.

Native video element made when selected, uses direct photo.video, playsInline, auto preload and muted by default. Play/pause, sound toggle and pointer scrubber. Only current video plays; leaving resets playback to0. Sound setting stays in memory until reload.
More toggles Save Photo / Copy Link menu; outside click or Escape closes it. Escape prioritizes menu, then info, then viewer.

Fetches photo.save to Blob/File. Supported mobile shares actual file via navigator.share; desktop downloads blob using temporary object URL revoked after4s. Loading errors show Photo Unavailable; lost activation may show Tap Again to Save.
Focus is moved only after keyboard use, to Back on opening and source tile on closing. Tab loops visible enabled .tl-round/.tl-pill-btn controls; no inert background is set.

grid_interactions: Years/Months/All views; year/month cards drill down.
Library button morphs into Library/Favorites tabs,420ms cubic-bezier(.3,.9,.3,1).
Grid columns change via pinch or Ctrl+wheel: phone1/3/5; desktop4/6/8/12.
Grid lazy expansion prepends CHUNK240 older photos with scroll offset compensation; sample231photos fits current initial chunk.
Date heading updates while page scrolls; newest position aligns just above bottom toolbar.

storage.in_memory: Viewer page and strip DOM made once; image URL assigned once when nearby. Up to5 saved file promises/files cached in memory; no IndexedDB, Cache API or service worker. Sound/favorites active tab not persistently stored.
storage.photo_prefetch: Current±2 photos full srcset, filmstrip±24 tiny images. When canShareFiles, current still image save blob is prefetched500ms after selection and on Share pointerdown. Browser HTTP caching remains browser/server controlled.

network.pagination: Only when data.pages>1; current page URL plus view=tlog-data&page=n.
network.images: Protocol-relative fugazi.net CDN data; derived widths120/400/800/1000/2000; save3000. Original URLs have existing version query, so width appends work.
network.videos: Direct photo.video MP4 data; fetched only when relevant player/save invokes it.
network.save_share: Fetch(blob) requires remote media CORS; normal cross-origin image display alone does not prove Save works.

required_static_adaptations.problem: Copy Link points to nonexistent Shopify search template on GitHub Pages and drops repository path.
required_static_adaptations.recommended: For a runnable port, copy current static page URL with #photo-ID; preserve exact source in original archive.

required_static_adaptations.problem: On project Pages this navigates account-root site, outside /0AR5TAS/.
required_static_adaptations.recommended: Use an explicit project test-home URL or explicit external source-home URL according to intended navigation.

other_portability_notes: Viewport/grid CSS and SVG icon sprite are required; do not extract controller alone.

Root standard browser APIs: matchMedia, Promise, fetch, native scroll containers, requestAnimationFrame, URL/history, Pointer/Touch events, localStorage, optional IntersectionObserver/WAAPI/clipboard/WebShare.
reduced-motion is sampled at initialization, not listened for later changes.
Hash deep-link only checked at initialization; arbitrary later hashchange is not handled.
Global popstate always closes the viewer; no SPA/router ownership boundary.
Video slider is role=slider but has no tabindex or keyboard-specific seek handling.
Save names still files .jpg although actual MIME type is taken from Blob; source format may differ.
No feature destroy lifecycle exists; do not initialize twice.
verification: Read-only analysis of supplied local source files; no live browser interactions, runtime edits or GitHub writes.
